Name: 1oxnes and talkohlooeys' style Swaggon portrait
Author: zylistic
Description:
[size=2]Do you use [color=#1e84cc][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30727]1oxnes and talkohlooeys' portrait mod[/url][/color] and wish you could change Scar's look to match? No? Just me? Well, here you go anyway![/size][size=3]

[b][u]IMPORTANT:[/u] THIS MOD REQUIRES [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SPACECORE[/url] AND [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23401]THE SWAGGON![/url]﻿
[/b][/size][size=2]It makes use of SpaceCore's texture override in order to scale the portrait size up, and obviously needs The Swaggon as a prerequisite. It won't work otherwise![/size][size=3]

[b]INSTALLATION:[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install the required mods ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url]﻿, and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23401]The Swaggon[/url]﻿).
[*]Extract the folder into your Mods folder and install like usual.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list][size=4]
[/size][size=2]Big thanks to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/fishbloc?gameId=1303]fishbloc[/url] for giving me permission to make and upload this! Originally it was just for myself but I uploaded it anyway to let others use it if they'd like.
Massive shoutout to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/DacarTheGorilla?gameId=1303]DacarTheGorilla[/url]﻿ for letting me use their code and teaching me how to use SpaceCore's texture override, helping make this mod possible in the first place! Check out their mods too, particularly their [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32067]Anime Style Vendor Portraits[/url]﻿!
Also a small thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/1249127]DolphinIsNotaFish[/url] for pointing me to Dacar's HD portraits in the official Stardew Discord![/size]

Downloads.Description: HD Portrait for The Swaggon mod.
